battle.name: 郝孝德起義
battle.brief: 大業九年（613）冬，隋煬帝再征高句液晶盡，齊郡平原人郝孝德聚眾數萬起兵反隋，與王薄、孫宣雅互相聲援，攻下章丘。隋將張須陀追討，於章丘北破其眾，殘部西散，後歸瓦崗李密，與徐世勣合兵據黎陽倉，自號平原公。卡面月牙劍屬古埃及青銅時代工藝，相隔千七百年，不在此役現場。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 這場起義發生在隋大業九年（613）冬，是隋末天下大亂之中北方最早成氣候的一批義軍之一。起義方是山東黃河北岸的起義隊伍，首領郝孝德是齊郡平原郡（今山東德州平原縣）人，聚合起義眾數萬，與同在山東活動的王薄（長平人）、孫宣雅（泰山郡人）互相呼應，並一度攻下齊郡章丘縣，掌握濟北一帶的鄉里與倉糧。起義方並非單一建制，而是由數支隊伍在戰事中合流而成，郝孝德以首領身份居中調度，號令與糧秣多靠各部自籌，既無固定編制，也無常設的指揮系統。鎮壓方是隋廷的北方軍事力量：齊郡、渤海郡、濟北郡一帶的州郡兵，隸屬於河北道各總管府，關鍵人物是隋將張須陀，他以率騎兵追討潰散義軍著稱，此前先後平定竇抗、王薄、劉海等部，是隋廷在山東唯一能壓住局面的將領。隋廷本身正把主力投入第二次征討高句麗，河北山東多數郡縣的守兵空虛，這是義軍得以聚眾的直接條件；義軍與官軍在平原、章丘、黎陽一線的反覆拉鋸，構成本役的交戰面。第三方主要是高句麗與北方邊軍：官軍追擊義軍時曾把部分人眾逼向東北，與高句麗方面形成牽扯，義軍首領與高句麗之間的往來，成為隋廷最為戒心之事。
countriesEn: This rising broke out in the winter of Daye 9 (613) and was one of the earliest large risings in the north during the general collapse of the Sui. The insurgents came from the north bank of the Yellow River in Shandong: the leader Hao Xiaode was a native of Pingyuan commandery in Qi (present-day Pingyuan county, Dezhou, Shandong), and he gathered tens of thousands of fighters, answered in turn by two other bands operating in the same province, Wang Bo, a native of Changping, and Sun Xuanya of Taishan commandery, and they at one point seized Zhangqiu county in Qi commandery, holding the countryside and the granaries of northern Ji. The insurgent side was not a single formation but several rebel bands that merged as the fighting went on, with Hao Xiaode holding the middle as commander; orders and supply were largely raised by each contingent on its own, and there was neither a fixed establishment nor a permanent command structure. The side that put the rising down was the Sui's northern military establishment, the troops of the prefectures and commanderies of Qi, Bohai and Jibei, all under the regional headquarters of the Hebei circuit; the decisive figure was the Sui general Zhang Xutuo, famous for pursuing routed rebels with cavalry and for successively breaking the bands of Dou Kang, Wang Bo and Liu Hai, and he was the only commander on whom the Sui court could rely in Shandong to hold the line. The court itself had thrown its main strength into the second campaign against Goguryeo, and most prefectures and counties of Hebei and Shandong were stripped of garrison troops, which is the immediate condition that let the insurgents muster. The confrontation between rebels and imperial troops along the plain, Zhangqiu and Liyang lines forms the field of this campaign. The third parties were mainly Goguryeo and the northern frontier forces: as the imperial troops pressed the rebels northward, part of them was pushed towards the northeast and had dealings with Goguryeo, and the traffic between rebel leaders and that kingdom became the thing the Sui court feared most.
people: 郝孝德是本役的主角。他是齊郡平原郡人，起義之前並無顯名，隋廷大舉募兵遠征高句麗、河北山東空虛之際，他才聚眾數萬，於大業九年（613）冬天響應，跨黃河活動於濟北與齊郡一帶；他曾與王薄、孫宣雅兩支起義軍互相策應，攻取章丘，把義軍的活動範圍推到齊郡腹地。郡望出身說明他在地方上有人望，能在短時間內聚集數萬人眾，靠的是鄉里的響應而不是朝廷的軍籍。隋廷方面的關鍵人物是張須陀，潁川老闇人出身，善用騎兵，每戰先以輕騎迫近義軍陣前、迫其散亂，再以步騎合擊潰兵，利用山東平原開闊、河流縱橫的地形追擊；他先後平定竇抗、王薄、劉海，於章丘一線擊破郝孝德，迫其眾散。竇抗在渤海郡起兵後被張須陀擊潰，敗走高句麗；王薄在長平起兵，兵敗被殺；孫宣雅退入泰山郡的山中，又被張須陀攻破。這幾位首領的結局說明，隋末的起義多是一時蜂起，缺少統一指揮與後方經營。郝孝德是少數沒有死在隋軍手上的起義首領：他在章丘失利後收拾殘部西行，後歸附瓦崗軍李密，與李密部將徐世勣合兵，佔據黎陽倉，自稱平原公。此後瓦崗軍以黎陽倉的儲糧為基地，郝孝德成為瓦崗集團的主要首領之一；劉黑闥早年在郝孝德麾下聚眾為盜，後來才歸李密為部將。
peopleEn: Hao Xiaode is the central figure of the campaign. He was a native of Pingyuan in Qi commandery, with no recorded eminence before the fighting, and came to prominence only in the winter of Daye 9 (613), when the Sui court had mustered troops for the renewed march into Goguryeo and Hebei and Shandong lay empty of garrisons; at that moment he gathered tens of thousands and rose, moving across the Yellow River in Jibei and Qi. He coordinated in turn with the bands of Wang Bo and Sun Xuanya, and the capture of Zhangqiu pushed the insurgents deep into the heart of Qi commandery. His origins among the local gentry explain how he could assemble tens of thousands within weeks: his strength was local response, not a Sui muster roll. The key man on the Sui side was Zhang Xutuo, a native of Laoyin in Yingchuan, skilled in cavalry, who in every engagement first pressed the insurgents' front with light horse, forced them into disorder, and then closed on the scattered with foot and horse, using the open ground and the rivers of the Shandong plain to run them down; he had already destroyed Dou Kang, Wang Bo and Liu Hai, and at Zhangqiu he broke Hao Xiaode's band and scattered it. Dou Kang had risen in Bohai commandery and, defeated, fled to Goguryeo; Wang Bo, who had risen at Changping, was killed after his defeat; Sun Xuanya withdrew into the mountains of Taishan and was stormed there. The fates of these leaders show that most Sui-era risings were sudden swells without a unified command and without a rear base. Hao Xiaode was one of the few rebel chiefs who was not killed by the Sui army: after the failure at Zhangqiu he gathered the remnants and moved west, then entered the Wagang army of Li Mi, combining with Li Mi's general Xu Shiji to occupy the granary of Liyang and taking the title Duke of Pingyuan. From then on the granary at Liyang gave the Wagang group a base, and Hao Xiaode became one of its principal chiefs; Liu Heita had once gathered bandits under Hao Xiaode before entering Li Mi's service.
kits: 卡面這把埃及月牙劍屬古埃及的工藝：外彎的單刃，刃口向外、刀背內凹，砍進之後不必把刃拔出，可以省力，也可以避免折斷刃身；它比直劍更早出現在埃及人手上，流行於公元前十六至前十一世紀前後。它與大業九年的山東起義相隔一千七百餘年，在本役現場不可能出現，戰場上真正交手的兵器另有其物。起義軍這邊是典型的鄉里武裝：步卒為主，人數雖多而器械簡陋，多用柴刀、環首刀、長柄矛與桑木杆的矛，弓以桑柘木為胎，箭鏃式樣雜亂，還有漁叉、木盾與獵具改造的器械；鎧甲極少，多靠皮甲、布甲甚至厚衣抵禦，騎兵比例很低，只在後來與瓦崗軍合流、取得馬匹之後才有可觀的騎兵。隋軍這邊則是官軍裝備：環首刀與方刃直刀、長矛、弓箭與臂弩，鎧甲有明光鎧、兜鍪與披膊，攻城與野戰備有鎬、盾、橦車、巢車與投石機，軍中置鼓與鼓車用於發號施令，馬匹是官軍在山東平原追逐義軍的關鍵。正面交手多在步卒進退之間完成：起義軍靠人數與地形掩護，官軍靠騎兵機動與裝備差距；雙方真正拉開距離的其實是糧秣，義軍多就地取糧，官軍則靠漕運與屯田維持。郝孝德後來佔據黎陽倉，取的正是隋廷在河北黃河沿線囤積的軍糧，這一點對後續戰局的影響，比任何一件兵器都大。
kitsEn: The Egyptian khopesh on the card is a piece of Egyptian craftwork: a single-edged blade curved outward, with the edge on the convex side and the back hollowed, which could be driven into a body and left there without being worked back out, saving effort and sparing the blade from breaking; it appeared in Egyptian hands earlier than the straight sword and was in use roughly from the sixteenth to the eleventh century BC. It stands more than seventeen hundred years away from the rising in Shandong in Daye 9 and could not have been on that battlefield; the arms that actually met there were something else entirely. The insurgents fought as a typical village levy, infantry in the main: numerous but poorly equipped, armed with hatchets, ring-pommel sabres, long-handled spears and spear-shafts of mulberry wood, bows of mulberry or tallow-wood with arrowheads of mixed and rough pattern, and with fishing prongs, wooden shields and hunting gear converted to weapons; armour was scarce, and what existed was leather, cloth or padded clothing, while the proportion of cavalry was very low and became noticeable only later, after the merger with the Wagang army brought horses. The Sui troops carried the equipment of a regular army: ring-pommel sabres and straight single-edged blades, long spears, bows and crossbows, armour in the form of shining-plated mail with helmets and shoulder guards, and for field and siege work pickaxe, shield, tower carts, siege ladders and stone-throwers, with drums and drum carts used to signal orders; horses were the key to the imperial cavalry hunting the insurgents across the Shandong plain. Most close contact was settled between advancing and retiring infantry: the insurgents relied on numbers and familiar ground, the imperial side on cavalry movement and the gap in equipment. What really separated the two was supply; the insurgents took their grain from the immediate countryside, while the imperial army was sustained by the canal transport and the garrison farms of Hebei. When Hao Xiaode later took Liyang, what he was taking was the military grain the Sui had stored along the Yellow River, and that single fact mattered more to the later course of the war than any weapon.
tactics: 起義軍的戰法以流動與襲擾為主。郝孝德起兵之初並無攻取大城的本錢，部眾分散在平原、章丘一帶的鄉里與山澤水泊之間，遇官軍則散、官軍退則合，憑人數與熟悉地形的優勢周旋；與王薄、孫宣雅聯合之後，聯合作戰的規模明顯擴大，攻下章丘是這批義軍最深入的行動。隋軍的戰術則集中於騎兵機動：張須陀以輕騎迫近義軍陣前，迫其散亂，再以步騎合擊潰兵，利用山東平原開闊、河流縱橫的地形追擊；對退入山中的孫宣雅部，他改以步卒攀緣圍攻，不與之曠野決戰。義軍在不利於自己的正面交鋒中屢屢受挫，深層原因是補給線過短：隊伍一散，糧秣即斷，而官軍背後有河北的郡縣倉儲與運河漕運可以支撐持久作戰。從大業九年冬到大業十年春，山東一線的義軍此起彼落，隋廷的策略是集中一位能打的主將逐部殲滅，避免同時分兵。郝孝德部在章丘的失敗，正是這種以騎兵追、以主力殲的打法的結果；而他之後轉入瓦崗、佔據黎陽倉，等於換了一種打法：不再四處流竄，而是以城池與糧倉為根據地，向北與官軍相持，向南與李密、徐世勣的部眾合流，把起義從流寇式的流動戰，改成了有據點的持久戰。
tacticsEn: The insurgents' method was one of movement and harassment. Hao Xiaode at the outset lacked the means for taking a great city, and his bands were dispersed through the villages and the marsh and hill country between Pingyuan and Zhangqiu, breaking up when the imperial troops came and re-forming when they withdrew, turning their numbers and their familiarity with the ground to account; after the union with Wang Bo and Sun Xuanya the scale of joint action grew markedly, and the taking of Zhangqiu was the deepest move those bands made. The Sui method concentrated on cavalry manoeuvre: Zhang Xutuo pressed the insurgents' front with light horse, forced them into disorder, and then closed on the scattered with foot and horse, using the open ground and the rivers of the Shandong plain to run them down; against Sun Xuanya, who had retired into the hills of Taishan, he changed to an assault on foot up the slopes rather than a pitched battle in the open. The insurgents were repeatedly checked in engagements that favoured their opponents, and the underlying reason was the shortness of their supply line: once a band dispersed its grain was cut off, while the imperial troops had the county granaries and the canal transport of Hebei behind them. From the winter of Daye 9 into the spring of the following year the insurgent bands rose and fell one after another along the Shandong line, and the court's answer was to concentrate one competent commander against them in turn rather than to divide the force; the same policy that let Zhang Xutuo range the plain with cavalry and then close with the main body destroyed Hao Xiaode's band at Zhangqiu. His later turn to the Wagang and his occupation of the granary at Liyang amounted to a change of method: no longer roving from place to place, but holding a city and a granary as a base, standing in the north against the imperial army and joining Li Mi and Xu Shiji's men in the south, converting the rising from the fluid warfare of a routed mob into a war fought from fixed positions.
data: 能確定的數字大致如下。大業九年（613），隋煬帝再征高句麗，天下發兵百餘萬，糧秣轉輸的消耗使河北山東的郡縣幾乎抽空守兵，這正是同年二月起於長平的王薄、冬季起於平原的郝孝德、泰山郡的孫宣雅、渤海郡的竇抗能夠同時蜂起的直接原因。郝孝德聚眾的規模，《隋書》與《資治通鑑》記為數萬；他所佔領的城邑是齊郡章丘縣，即今山東章丘一帶。鎮壓方主將張須陀的戰果，傳世史籍記其在山東追討起義時多有斬首數萬級的記載，但各條記載分屬不同戰役，郝孝德一部究竟損失多少，史料並無分列。時間線上有兩個能對上的點：起事在大業九年冬，隋軍的決定性打擊落在其後一年，即大業十年（614）春；此後郝孝德西走，歸瓦崗軍，與徐世勣合兵佔黎陽倉，自號平原公。黎陽倉是隋代黃河沿線的儲糧重地之一，瓦崗軍據此取糧之後，關東的局勢便從四處流竄變成據倉待糧。至於起義的確切月份，傳世史籍沒有明確記載，卡面標為十一月，取的是該役在通鑑編年中出現於冬季的讀法。距離方面，平原郡治到章丘縣不過百餘里，是一郡之隔的短程戰線；郝孝德由山東北上南下到黎陽倉，行程數百里，但那是另一階段的行動。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. In Daye 9 (613) the Sui Yangdi mustered over a million men for the renewed campaign against Goguryeo, and the burden of moving their food and supplies drew the able-bodied and the draught animals out of Hebei and Shandong almost completely, which is the direct reason why Wang Bo's rising at Changping in the second month, Hao Xiaode's in the north in the winter, Sun Xuanya's in Taishan commandery and Dou Kang's in Bohai commandery could all rise at the same time. The size of Hao Xiaode's following is given in the Suishu and the Zizhi Tongjian as tens of thousands, and the county he occupied was Zhangqiu in Qi commandery, that is, the neighbourhood of present-day Zhangqiu in Shandong. As for the results of the Sui commander Zhang Xutuo, the transmitted histories record several instances of tens of thousands of heads taken in his pursuit of the Shandong insurgents, but the entries belong to different engagements and the histories do not break out a separate figure for Hao Xiaode's band. Two points on the timeline can be fixed: the rising began in the winter of Daye 9, and the decisive blow from the imperial troops fell in the spring of the following year, Daye 10 (614); Hao Xiaode then moved west, entered the Wagang army, joined Xu Shiji and occupied the granary at Liyang, styling himself Duke of Pingyuan. Liyang was one of the Sui's great depots of grain along the Yellow River, and once the Wagang army held it, the situation east of the passes changed from roving through the villages to holding a depot of grain. As for the exact month of the rising, the transmitted histories do not record it clearly, and the card gives the eleventh month, following the reading in the annalistic Tongjian that the affair appeared in winter. As for distance, the seat of Pingyuan commandery to the county of Zhangqiu is a little over a hundred li, a short line of country within a single commandery; Hao Xiaode's later move from northern Shandong down to Liyang was several hundred li, but that belongs to a later phase of the affair.
cause: 起義的直接原因是隋廷的無限役與兵力空虛。大業八年（608）與九年（613），隋煬帝兩度大舉征討高句麗，發兵以百萬計，糧秣轉輸沿著沁水、汴渠與河北運河一線徵發，河北山東的丁壯與畜力被大量抽調；各地同時需供應運夫與軍糧，供應線拉得極長。第二次出征正逢山東、河北連年水旱，郡縣倉儲被調空，法令在地方上難以維持。次要而直接的觸發點是軍隊的重新集結與派防調換：鄉里青壯被編入遠征大軍或徵發為運夫，隊伍在集結、行軍與解散的混亂中脫離建制，兵器隨手帶走，成為義軍最初的人與械的來源；留在鄉里的部分人則趁郡縣守兵空虛、官署權威崩解之際起而響應，郝孝德正是在這樣的間隙中聚起數萬人眾。深一層看，起義所反對的並非朝廷，而是那種把全部資源壓上前線的體制：賦稅、徭役、兵役同時加到一個已不勝負荷的地區，天子的號令在地方上失效，義兵的名號便有了土壤。郝孝德選擇在黃河北岸、平原這樣的郡縣起事，也說明他的訴求是趁亂自保與自立，而非跨地域的舉兵；王薄、孫宣雅、竇抗在同一時間的響應，才使這一帶的反抗有了互相呼應的規模。
causeEn: The direct cause of the rising was the unlimited levies of the Sui court and the resulting emptiness of the provinces. In 608 and again in 613 Emperor Yang campaigned against Goguryeo on a vast scale, raising a million men and drawing grain and transport along the Qin river, the Bian canal and the Hebei waterways, while every district also had to find men for transport teams and for the commissariat; the second expedition coincided with repeated floods and droughts in Shandong and Hebei, the county granaries were emptied to feed it, and the law of the court could no longer be enforced in the localities. The immediate spark was the muster and the reshuffling of the armies: the young men of the villages were enrolled in the expedition or taken for transport duty, and men slipped out of formation in the confusion of mustering, marching and disbanding, carrying away their weapons as they went; those who stayed behind rose to answer when the garrisons of the counties were empty and the authority of the offices had broken down, and Hao Xiaode gathered tens of thousands in precisely such an interval. At a deeper level what the rising opposed was not the court as such but a system that pressed all its resources onto a single front: taxation, corvée and military service all fell at once on a region already past bearing, the emperor's orders ceased to function locally, and the name of righteous army found soil in which to grow. That Hao Xiaode chose to rise in Pingyuan, on the north bank of the Yellow River in Shandong, shows that his claim was local self-preservation and self-assertion rather than a rising across regions; it was the answering response of Wang Bo, Sun Xuanya and Dou Kang at the same time that gave the resistance in this belt the scale of a mutual summons.
impact: 郝孝德起義的直接後果是河北山東的秩序崩解。隋廷在山東必須倚賴張須陀一人逐部平叛，凡是張須陀無法抵達之處，義軍就能站住腳；章丘之役後，郝孝德雖然西走，但他所集起的數萬人眾並未解散，而是分頭投向其他旗號，孫宣雅部在泰山郡收拾殘部再起，即是明證。郝孝德本人歸附瓦崗軍李密、與徐世勣合兵佔據黎陽倉，對後續格局的影響更為長遠：黎陽倉的儲糧使瓦崗軍有了可以據守的根據地，關東的起義從此有了補給來源，隋朝的黃河防線被從內部掀開一個口子。郝孝德自號平原公，也就承認了瓦崗軍由起義隊伍向割據政權過渡的開始。此後數年間，關東先後出現夏（竇建德）、鄭（王世充）、魏（李密）等並立，最終由李淵在關中建立的唐朝收拾舊局；郝孝德這一代的起義首領，多數在建國之前已死或散去，能像他這樣由起義首領轉為割據勢力核心成員的並不多見。裝備層面的影響同樣不小：河北山東的鄉里兵器，以及官軍在敗散時丟下的甲兵與馬匹，在混戰中大量流入各部義軍，瓦崗軍後來能夠成建制地配甲配馬，源頭正是這幾年的大小起義。對隋朝而言，這場起義是壓垮體制的又一根槓桿，它本身並不致命，卻讓一次遠征解決一切的思路徹底破產。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of Hao Xiaode's rising was the breakdown of order in Hebei and Shandong. The Sui court in Shandong had come to depend on Zhang Xutuo alone to suppress the rebels, and wherever he could not arrive the insurgents were able to hold their ground; after the affair at Zhangqiu, Hao Xiaode had gone west, but the tens of thousands he had gathered did not dissolve, they went to other banners in fragments, and the remnants of Sun Xuanya rising again in Taishan commandery is plain proof of it. Hao Xiaode's own move into the Wagang army of Li Mi, and his combination with Xu Shiji to hold the granary at Liyang, had a longer reach: the grain stored at Liyang gave the Wagang army a base it could defend, the rising in the east acquired a source of supply, and the Sui's Yellow River line was prised open from within. Hao Xiaode's styling himself Duke of Pingyuan also marks the beginning of the Wagang group's passage from an armed band to a territorial power. Over the following years the east of the passes saw a number of regimes stand side by side, Xia under Dou Jiande, Zheng under Wang Shichong, Wei under Li Mi, before the dynasty founded by Li Yuan in Guanzhong finally settled the old business; most of the rebel leaders of Hao Xiaode's generation were dead or scattered before the new state was founded, and few of them, like him, made the move from rebel chief to core member of a regional power. The effect at the level of equipment was no less real: the village weapons of Hebei and Shandong, and the imperial armour and horses left behind when formations broke, flowed into the rebel bands in large quantities during these years of fighting, and it was from this source that the Wagang army came to be able to equip its men with armour and horses in formed units. For the Sui, this rising was one more lever upon the system, not a fatal blow in itself, but the one that finished off the idea that a single expedition could settle everything.
result: 本役的結局是義軍失敗、人物存活並轉投他方。章丘之役中，張須陀的騎兵擊破郝孝德部，義軍在濟北的據點被攻破，部眾潰散於黃河南北，郝孝德率殘部西走，在隨後的日子裡歸附瓦崗軍李密，與李密部將徐世勣合兵，佔據黎陽倉，自稱平原公，成為瓦崗集團的主要首領之一。官軍這邊，張須陀在山東接連平定竇抗、王薄、孫宣雅與郝孝德各部，隋廷在河北的局勢一度穩住；但穩定只是暫時的，因為義軍的殘部與糧秣都轉入了更強的瓦崗軍，問題並未消失，只是換了主人。若把視線拉長，郝孝德起義的真正結果發生在十年之後：大業十二年（616），李密在黎陽一線擊破盤據當地的翟進部，將其眾併入瓦崗軍；到618年，李密敗於王世充，瓦崗軍瓦解，郝孝德的下落在史籍中便再無明確記載，而劉黑闥這位曾在郝孝德麾下為群盜的人，在河北重新聚兵、兩度掀起戰事，成為唐初平定河北時必須對付的對手。從兵器的角度說，這場起義現場沒有出現任何值得記載的新式武器，環首刀、長矛、弓箭與騎兵仍是全部；真正改變局面的，是糧倉的位置，以及站在糧倉一邊的人。
resultEn: The outcome of the campaign was a rebel defeat, with the leader surviving and changing sides. At Zhangqiu the cavalry of Zhang Xutuo broke Hao Xiaode's band, the base in northern Ji was stormed, the fighters scattered on both banks of the Yellow River, and Hao Xiaode took the remnants west; in the months that followed he entered Li Mi's Wagang army, combined with Li Mi's general Xu Shiji, occupied the granary at Liyang and styled himself Duke of Pingyuan, becoming one of the principal chiefs of the Wagang group. On the imperial side, Zhang Xutuo put down in turn the bands of Dou Kang, Wang Bo, Sun Xuanya and Hao Xiaode, and the Sui position in Hebei held for a while; but the stability was temporary, because the remnants and the grain of the rebels passed to the stronger Wagang army, and the trouble did not disappear, only changed hands. Pulled back further, the real outcome of Hao Xiaode's rising came ten years on: in 616 Li Mi broke the band of Zhai Jin near Liyang and absorbed its men into the Wagang army, and by 618 Li Mi had been defeated by Wang Shichong and the Wagang force had come apart, after which the histories record no clear trace of Hao Xiaode; Liu Heita, who had once been a bandit under Hao Xiaode, gathered a new army in Hebei and twice disturbed the north, becoming the opponent Tang had to deal with when the north was pacified. As for arms, nothing new or noteworthy appeared on the field in this rising: ring-pommel sabres, long spears, bows and cavalry were the whole of it. What changed the situation was the position of the granaries, and the side that stood beside them.
